card.name: Dots and slashes inside unit expressions
card.fires_on: Joining marks such as a middle dot, slash or semicolon inside compound units like mg•hr/L, μM•min and mL/min/1.73 m2. It fires on the mark after the first unit.

modes.label: Middle dot in exposure units
modes.description: A bullet or dot joins two units in area-under-the-curve measures.

modes.label: Slash in clearance units
modes.description: A slash follows mL/min before 1.73 m2 in kidney function values.

modes.label: Other separators in rates
modes.description: A slash or semicolon appears after a unit in per-day or per-person rate expressions.

card.plain: It marks the dot or slash that joins two parts of a compound unit, like mL/min per 1.73 m2.
